The '''Spider battleship''' was a nickname that was given by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] to one of the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] that was present among the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]].
